shiftLock.slot: Cap near selector base on console — Lexus may place release INSIDE center console storage bin
steps: Turn ignition to ON.
Locate the shift lock override slot — Cap near selector base on console — Lexus may place release INSIDE center console storage bin.
Insert a thin key or flathead into the slot and press firmly down.
While holding the slot, press the brake pedal.
Move the selector to Neutral.
Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to N normally.
If using slot without power, apply consistent firm pressure — hybrid selectors may require more force.
Hybrid: 12V auxiliary only — never touch HV battery.

tow.method: FWD: lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air. AWD: flatbed only. AWD without flatbed: wheel-lift with dollies on opposite axle. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: HYBRID/PHEV: Use 12V auxiliary battery ONLY for jumping. NEVER access the high-voltage battery pack.
FWD: lift from front (front/drive wheels in the air) freely. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.

battery.jumpPoints: Under hood — standard terminals. Hybrid: 12V only.
battery.warning: Hybrid: 12V auxiliary only. Hybrid: 12V auxiliary only — never touch the HV battery.

shiftLock.slot: Cap near selector base on console
steps: Turn ignition to ON (do not start engine).
Locate the shift lock override slot — Cap near selector base on console.
Pry off the cap or cover if present using your ignition key or a small flathead.
Insert the key (or a thin flathead) into the slot and press firmly downward.
While holding the slot, press the brake pedal.
Move the selector from Park to Neutral.
Remove key from slot and replace cap.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood or in trunk — varies by generation.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.
If power cannot be restored, use the shift lock slot above — Cap near selector base on console.

notes: MANUAL TRANSMISSION OPTION: If equipped with manual trans, no shift lock — depress clutch and select Neutral. No override slot needed.

Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood.

TRANSFER CASE: must be shifted to 2WD/2H before towing. IF BATTERY IS DEAD: jump battery FIRST, shift TC to 2WD, then disconnect. If TC cannot be shifted: FLATBED ONLY.

tow.method: Transfer case to H2 (2WD) first, then lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air, or flatbed. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: ELECTRONIC TRANSFER CASE: Requires 12V power to shift. If battery is dead, jump the battery FIRST, then shift TC to 2WD before disconnecting.
DEAD BATTERY FALLBACK: If TC cannot be shifted to 2WD, USE FLATBED. Do NOT tow with TC in 4WD/4H/4L — will destroy transfer case and driveline.
4WD DOLLY FALLBACK: If transfer case CANNOT be shifted to 2WD (dead battery, mechanical failure), either use flatbed OR wheel-lift with dollies on the opposite axle.

battery.warning: KDSS equipped trims: suspension may shift when lifted.

alerts.warning: Must shift transfer case to 2H/2WD before road towing. Never tow in 4H or 4L on dry pavement — drivetrain damage.

issues.title: Kinetic Dynamic Suspension System (KDSS)
issues.detail: Some GX 460 trims have KDSS (hydraulic stabilizer bar disconnect). This system can behave unexpectedly when the vehicle is lifted. Be aware that suspension geometry may shift more than expected when lifting one end.
